note_gaps: No paper exists for this key (repository only, no papers/md file). Code md provenance is README + pruned file tree + ~27 Python files' signatures; no CUDA/Taichi kernel bodies were captured, so solver-iteration counts, convergence tolerances, and exact contact-model equations are not verifiable from the parsed material and are marked not-stated rather than inferred further. The MuJoCo-lineage/noslip contact-model characterization is inferred from module and reference names, not confirmed with solref/solimp-equivalent parameters in the captured signatures.
contact_model: Constraint-based rigid solver (equality/inequality constraints, plus an explicit noslip() post-pass, architecturally similar to MuJoCo's solver+noslip design) combined with multi-material coupling: FEM, MPM, particle-based PBD and SPH, a libuipc Incremental Potential Contact solver, an explicit inter-solver coupler, and a SAP (semi-analytic-primal-style) compliant-contact path used for grasp-coupling scenes.
solver: ConstraintSolver with Newton-style line-search iterative resolve (linesearch.py) and constraint-island decomposition for parallelism (island.py); multiple pluggable physics solvers (Rigid, FEM, MPM, PBD, SPH, libuipc, SAP) compiled via the Quadrants (Taichi-derived) backend.
